transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I came in because I got scared of my own thoughts. I keep thinking it would be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but having that thought over and over frightened me.
Have you lost interest or felt less pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
Yes. I used to look forward to doing my watercolors, going to dance class, and walking with the ladies. Lately I just leave my things sitting there and I can’t make myself care about any of it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed the day before it even starts. It stays with me a lot of the day.
Have you been feeling guilty or felt like you're a burden to others lately?
Yes… I have. When I get tired or annoyed with my aunt, I feel terrible afterward. I start thinking I’m a bad woman, like I should be more grateful, and that I’m bringing shame on my family.
Have you noticed that you're moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you felt restless or fidgety lately?
Yes, I think slower. My husband says I move like everything takes extra effort now. Even at the market, I’ll just stand there too long before I pick up what I came for.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
I don’t think so… not anything I’ve really noticed. My eating seems about the same, and I haven’t been paying much attention to my weight.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About four months now… since my aunt came to live with us. That’s when I really started feeling this way.
Have you felt more tired or noticed a loss of energy lately, even after resting?
Yes. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I still wake up feeling worn out. Little things, like making breakfast or carrying laundry, feel like they take more out of me than they should.
Have you ever felt this way before, with similar sadness or loss of interest, or is this the first time you've experienced these feelings?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had sad times before, like anybody, but I don’t know if it was like this. This feels different to me, but I can’t say for sure.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt this same kind of sadness or loss of interest for at least two weeks or more?
I don’t really know. I’ve had times I was down before, but I can’t remember it being this same kind of thing for two weeks or more. This feels different.
Can you think back and recall if there was a time before this current period when you felt down or uninterested for two weeks or more?
I’m trying to think back, but I really can’t say for sure. I know I’ve had rough patches before, but I don’t remember a clear time where it lasted two weeks or more like this.
Can you think back to any time in your life before these last four months when you felt down or uninterested for a period of two weeks or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like this time?

I honestly can’t think of a clear time like that before these last months. I’ve had times where I was sad or not myself, but I don’t remember it lasting two weeks or more in a way I could really point to.
Can you think back to any time in your life before these last four months when you felt down or uninterested for a period of two weeks or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like this time?

I know you’ve asked, and I’m sorry, I just can’t come up with a time before this where I was like that for two weeks or more. I had bad days and rough times, but nothing I can clearly remember lasting like this.
Can you think back to any time in your life before these last four months when you felt down or uninterested for a period of two weeks or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like this time?
I’m sorry, I still can’t really think of one. Before these last four months, I had times I felt low, but I don’t remember a stretch that was two weeks or more.
Can you recall any time in your life before these last four months when you felt down or uninterested for a full week or more, even if it wasn’t as severe as this time?
I don’t really recall a full week either. I mean, I’ve had days here and there where I felt down, but before this, I can’t point to a whole week where it stayed that way.
